name: football_analytics
description: Import the team's `Premier_League_5_Years.sql` into a PostgreSQL database. From the project root, run `npm ci`, set `PGHOST`, `PGPORT`, `PGDATABASE`, `PGUSER`, and `PGPASSWORD` for that database, and run `node server.mjs`. Open [Analytics](http://localhost:3000/analytics.html). The server reads the `pl_history` schema using the same PostgreSQL pool as Players and Teams.
